prompts.prompt: Arista EOS 4.35 added a Cluster Load Balancing feature for optimizing RoCE traffic between GPU servers in AI clusters. Which switch platform family does this feature require? Answer concisely.
prompts.source: plugins/networking/skills/arista-eos/references/versions/4.35.md - Cluster Load Balancing requires compatible 7060DX4 or similar platforms

prompts.prompt: For Arista EOS, when does the 4.30.x release train reach end of software support? Answer concisely with the date.
On an Arista EOS VXLAN fabric, what MTU should you configure on spine-leaf and MLAG peer-link interfaces to account for VXLAN encapsulation overhead? Answer concisely with the number.
prompts.source: plugins/networking/skills/arista-eos/SKILL.md - MTU not 9214: VXLAN adds 50 bytes, all spine-leaf and peer-link interfaces must be MTU 9214
